items.title: Map current agent asset resolution into a mechanical inventory
items.context: Read prompt-registry, managed-assets, cli-init, codex adapter checks, and config doctor paths. Produce a runtime-owned vs project-local asset resolution projection without changing behavior.

happy.desc: A project with no .claude/agents and no .Codex/agents is classified as runtime-owned with prompt assets absent and a current promptRegistryHash.

edge.desc: A project with explicit full/local prompt assets is not misclassified as absent runtime-owned; local assets are listed individually.

adversarial.desc: The inventory never reports receiptVerified, authorityDone, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone from local prompt registry facts.

excludes: packages/main/src/core/managed-assets.ts: read for inventory context only; no managed asset repair/apply behavior changes in this story
packages/main/src/init-assets.ts: read for init behavior context only; no init asset generation behavior changes in this story
packages/main/src/cli-init.ts: read for init behavior context only; no init command behavior changes in this story

items.title: Expose runtime-owned asset status through existing doctor surfaces
items.context: Prefer extending doctor/codex_doctor/verify_codex/lattice_config_doctor rather than adding arbitrary new commands. Report runtime registry hash, project-local prompt assets, stale/matching/override classification, and Authority boundary.
items.userSees: Terminal shows "Codex agent asset resolution: pass runtime-owned registry=<sha256>; local prompt assets: absent; authorityBoundary=localNonAuthority".

happy.desc: verify_codex/diagnostic output includes a runtime-owned asset status check with registry hash and local Non-authority boundary text.

edge.desc: rollout diagnostics surface stale local prompt assets as warnings without suggesting automatic deletion or Authority completion.

adversarial.desc: Diagnostics do not add a new mutating command path and do not call apply/upgrade/repair during read-only checks.

excludes: docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-runtime-owned-agent-assets-execution-plan.md: source-of-truth reference only unless implementation discovers a factual doc correction
docs/audits/lattice-token-cost-and-takeover-audit.md: source-of-truth reference only unless token accounting numbers change

items.title: Add stale project-local prompt asset detection without repair or deletion
items.context: Detect .claude/agents and .Codex/agents materialized prompt files as absent/matches-runtime/stale/override. Do not auto-delete files and do not implement migration yet.
items.userSees: Terminal shows "projectPromptAssets: .claude/agents/koala-review-docs.md=stale action=review manually; file left unchanged".

happy.desc: Project-local prompt files matching runtime registry renderings are classified as matches-runtime.

edge.desc: Missing prompt asset directories are classified as absent and accepted for runtime-owned default.

adversarial.desc: A changed/stale prompt file is detected as stale or override and remains on disk after the diagnostic smoke completes.

items.title: Add regression smoke and token accounting record
items.context: Add tests proving runtime-owned default works without project-local templates, stale generated assets are detected, explicit full-asset mode remains distinguishable, and record measurable prompt/template token estimates for this story while stating actual provider billing is unavailable.

happy.desc: runtime-owned-agent-assets-smoke passes and prints the promptRegistryHash plus asset classification coverage.

edge.desc: prompt-token-cost-smoke still preserves B-bfb5 prompt savings and reports approximate token math, not billing tokens.

adversarial.desc: The smoke fails if output claims exact provider billing token usage or omits the unavailability caveat.

items.title: Complete Lattice local Non-authority review/test/done closure
items.context: Run required Lattice review and validation. Summary must separate localNonAuthorityAudit from Authority Server receipt-backed proof and must not claim receiptVerified, productionDone, authorityDone, or fullAuthorityDone.
items.userSees: Terminal shows "localNonAuthorityAudit=pass authorityServerPath=not-claimed receiptVerified=false authorityDone=false fullAuthorityDone=false".

happy.desc: REVIEW and TEST gates pass with evidence covering runtime-owned asset projection, stale detection, and token accounting.

edge.desc: Summary separates localNonAuthorityAudit from authorityServerPath and does not claim receipt-backed Authority completion.

adversarial.desc: DONE is not attempted while delivery-check, summary, stale evidence, or review escalation requirements are missing.
